$comment: The guided tour (tour.js). Each step points at an element (a CSS selector) on a page (#/<page>), or is centred when it has no target. Steps whose element is not on screen (a role without that feature) are skipped. 'views': only in that demo view ('user' or 'admin'). 'open': 'dock' opens the assistant first.

steps.title: Welcome to FoodRec
steps.text: FoodRec suggests recipes ranked by what matters to you, and shows exactly why. This short tour points out each part of the app. Use Next to follow it, or Skip to explore on your own.

steps.title: Your values
steps.text: Move the sliders to say how much each value counts. Apply tries them on this list only; Save as goal keeps them as a new version of your goal.

steps.title: Pick a meal
steps.text: Choose breakfast, lunch, dinner and so on to see recipes for that meal. This affects only the current list.

steps.title: A recommended recipe
steps.text: Each card shows the dish, its scores and the main reason it is here. React with Like, Save, I'll cook this or Not for me: the app learns from it, and saved dishes wait in My dishes.

steps.title: Why this rank?
steps.text: Open How it's scored to see every factor behind the scores, how each value contributed, and what is estimated or missing.

steps.title: The assistant
steps.text: Ask in plain words: "something easy with lentils", "why is #2 first?", "compare #1 and #3". Every step it takes is shown above its answer.

steps.title: The supervisor
steps.text: When your choices drift away from your saved goal, the supervisor asks a question or proposes a change here, with the evidence. Nothing changes until you accept.

steps.title: Your account
steps.text: Open this menu for My dishes (saved, liked and cooked), this tour, and the view switch: see the app as a user or as the administrator.

steps.title: Insights
steps.text: Compare the values you chose with how your choices actually weigh them, and see the evidence behind every change.

steps.title: Knowledge
steps.text: Explore the food knowledge graph and search the documents the assistant can cite.

steps.title: Activity
steps.text: Everything you did and every supervisor decision, newest first.

steps.title: The Config page
steps.text: In the admin view, the account menu has Config: the model, dataset, criteria, access roles and the study population. In the demo it is read-only.

steps.title: You are ready
steps.text: Try a few reactions on Discover and ask the assistant something. You can restart this tour any time from the account menu.
